Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Nikolaos Athanasiou (OFI) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Dimitrios Nikolaou (OFI).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Hapoel Be'er Sheva 0, OFI 1. Achilleas Poungouras (OFI) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner following a set piece situation.
First Half ends, Hapoel Be'er Sheva 0, OFI 1.
Second Half begins Hapoel Be'er Sheva 0, OFI 1.

Substitution, Hapoel Be'er Sheva. Igor Zlatanovic replaces Adrián Ugarriza.

Delay over. They are ready to continue.
